question: True or false: most US payday loans are repaid without another loan being taken within two weeks?
answer: False. The Consumer Financial Protection Bureau found that more than four in five payday loans were rolled over or followed by another within 14 days. Borrowers plan a two-week bridge; the repayment lands on a future self who is just as short of cash. The fee meant to be paid once returns month after month.
move: A plan that needs a richer future self usually meets the same self.
ask: When I borrow from next month, what makes me think next month's me will have more?
trap: True, since each loan is sold as a one-off two-week bridge.
reference: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, CFPB Data Point: Payday Lending, March 2014
